plugins.name: cap-deploy
plugins.description: Expert guidance for deploying SAP CAP apps to SAP BTP — production facets, MTA on Cloud Foundry, Kyma/Kubernetes, SAP HANA, XSUAA/approuter, hybrid testing, multitenancy, and CI/CD.

plugins.name: cap-extensibility
plugins.description: Expert guidance for extending SAP CAP models — extend/annotate, aspects, verticalization, exposing extension entities, SaaS tenant extensions via MTX, feature toggles, and extensibility governance.

plugins.name: cap-messaging
plugins.description: Expert guidance for event-driven SAP CAP — declaring events, emitting and subscribing, SAP Event Mesh / Cloud Application Event Hub brokers, CloudEvents, the transactional outbox, S/4HANA events, and deployment.

plugins.name: cap-remote-services
plugins.description: Expert guidance for consuming external services in SAP CAP — importing OData APIs (cds import), configuring remote services with destinations, querying with cds.connect.to, mocking, mashups, and resilience.

plugins.name: cap-testing
plugins.description: Expert guidance for testing SAP CAP applications — the cds.test harness, HTTP and programmatic service tests, authentication/mock users, test data, Java (JUnit) tests, and CI integration.

plugins.name: sap-cap
plugins.description: Expert guidance for building and extending SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) applications in Node.js or Java, declarative-first.

plugins.name: sap-fiori-tools
plugins.description: Expert guidance for SAP Fiori tools — generating, modeling, and previewing SAP Fiori elements apps with the Application Generator, Page Map, Guided Development, and annotation tooling in VS Code / SAP Business Application Studio.

plugins.name: sapui5
plugins.description: Expert guidance for building SAPUI5 / OpenUI5 applications — MVC with XML views, models and data binding, manifest.json, routing, UI5 Tooling, and Fiori elements.
